notes:
Two tablets paired together now work properly again.

If you use two tablets in Dual Mode, this is an important update. Three separate problems were found and fixed, all of which could leave the pair looking broken.

**The two tablets sometimes never connected at all.** Both screens stayed blank and nothing passed between them. The tablets were finding each other, but the connection was being abandoned a fraction of a second later because of a stale piece of Bluetooth bookkeeping held by the tablet doing the connecting. Restarting both apps used to be the only way out. That bookkeeping is now cleared before each attempt.

**Opening a piece flooded the link.** When you opened a piece, the tablet sent the whole of that piece's writing to the other one — every stroke on every page — and then did it again, repeatedly. On a heavily annotated piece that was over two megabytes each time, sent a dozen times, down a connection that carries about half a kilobyte per message. Everything else queued behind it: the second tablet's page could not arrive, so its screen stayed blank, and writing made on it took many seconds to appear on the first tablet, if it arrived at all.

The two tablets now compare a short summary of each page instead — a few hundred bytes for a whole piece — and send writing only for the pages that actually differ. When both tablets already agree, which is usually, nothing is sent at all. On a real piece this went from about two megabytes to twenty-six kilobytes.

**Closing a tab needed two or three taps.** The tab strip was mistaking the tap for the start of a sideways scroll and swallowing it. The × is also slightly wider now, though the tabs are no taller.

Both tablets need this update for the Dual Mode improvements to work between them.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
